description: Header file defining the TextureSelector and CopyTextureSelector classes for managing GPU textures with Direct3D 11 on Windows, including methods for creating textures, checking shared handle usage, and handling HDR modes.

classes.name: TextureSelector
classes.description: Manages different pixel formats and DXGI formats, checks for decoder GUID support, and creates texture wrappers.

classes.name: CopyTextureSelector
classes.description: Derived from TextureSelector, adds functionality for copying textures with optional color space and shared handle considerations.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a TextureSelector instance with specified preferences and formats.

methods.name: CreateTextureWrapper
methods.description: Creates a texture wrapper for the specified device and size.

methods.name: DoesDecoderOutputUseSharedHandle
methods.description: Checks if the decoder output uses a shared handle.

methods.name: WillCopyForTesting
methods.description: Indicates if the texture will be copied for testing purposes.
